concept: GuardDuty: ML threat detection from CloudTrail, Flow Logs, DNS
tests: Which service detects anomalous and malicious activity in the account using machine learning.
expected: Amazon GuardDuty — continuous analysis of CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs and DNS logs with ML and threat intelligence. Triggers: "anomalous activity", "unusual API calls", "known malicious IP", "machine learning".
why_not: AWS Config — configurations; WAF — web request filtering; Macie — finding sensitive data in S3.
